enter.description: Enter this AITP research workspace and return its grounded recorded state projection: recent entries, unresolved failures, next action, recent notes, counts, and warnings. Use at the start of a research session and before ending one, and before relying on any recorded project state.

parameters.name: recent
parameters.description: Number of recent active entries to project (default 20; must be positive).

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Optional workstream slug to scope the projection.

list.description: List canonical AITP ledger entries with optional kind, recorded-time, and workstream filters. Superseded entries remain visible. Use aitp_show for one complete entry and grep over .aitp/topic/ for full-text search.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only entries of this durable-event kind.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries recorded at or after this ISO date/timestamp (inclusive).

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Only entries explicitly in this workstream.

show.description: Open one exact AITP ledger entry by ID and return its complete frontmatter and body.

parameters.name: entry_id
parameters.description: Exact entry ID (for example entry-<32 hex>.md basename without .md).

check.description: Validate the whole AITP store read-only and report findings. Exit code 1 means findings were reported (warnings or errors), NOT a failed tool call; read the JSON payload and investigate errors before continuing.

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Scope findings to records that explicitly list this workstream.

exit_codes.2: AITPError JSON envelope or argparse misuse

backfill workstreams.description: Reviewed explicit workstream backfill for legacy AITP records. Dry-run by default. Requires a mapping JSON file and a human decision Entry whose refs sha256-pin the mapping. Apply only adds/merges frontmatter workstreams and never infers membership.

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.description: Workspace-contained mapping file (schema aitp/backfill-workstreams-0.1).

parameters.name: decision
parameters.description: Human decision Entry ID that sha256-pins the mapping file.

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Write the reviewed backfill; without this flag the command is dry-run only.

record prepare.description: Prepare a new AITP durable-event Entry draft. The result is a draft path only: read the draft, replace every template prompt with real content, then call aitp_record_save. Kinds: observation, result, failure, decision, source, code_change, run, closeout. Use authority "agent" for agent-authored records; created_by is required for agent authority.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: One durable-event kind; choose exactly one per event.

parameters.name: authority
parameters.description: Recording authority (default "agent").

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Provenance id (required when authority is "agent"); use agent:<name> or tool:<name>.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: Optional retry key; reusing it avoids duplicate drafts for the same logical write.

parameters.name: workstreams
parameters.description: Optional workstream slugs assigned to this entry.

record save.description: Validate and save a prepared AITP Entry draft into the canonical ledger. The draft must already be filled in.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Draft path returned by aitp_record_prepare (for example .aitp/local/drafts/entry-<id>.md).

note prepare.description: Prepare a new AITP Note draft (working or theory). The result is a draft path only: read the draft, fill every section and pinned basis_refs, then call aitp_note_save. Use a working note when several durable entries form a conclusion chain a returning session would reconstruct.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: working or theory note mode.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Short note title.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Provenance id; use agent:<name> for agent-authored notes.

parameters.name: workstreams
parameters.description: Optional workstream slugs assigned to this note.

note save.description: Validate and save a prepared AITP Note draft into the canonical ledger.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Draft path returned by aitp_note_prepare (for example .aitp/local/drafts/note-<id>.md).

operator_only.reason: blank-tree creation is a human operator decision
legacy bootstrap writes an inventory file and is operator-only

sync_rule: This file is the machine-readable adapter surface. AITP CLI, transport-schema, or Skill-surface changes must update it in the same change; consumers may fail closed when its sha256 or version is unknown.
